title: Amplify for web and mobile apps, IoT Core for devices

kcs.statement: AWS Amplify provides tools and hosting to build, deploy and host full-stack web and mobile applications quickly, wiring in back-end features such as authentication, storage and APIs.
AWS IoT Core securely connects IoT devices to the cloud and routes their messages (over MQTT or HTTPS) to AWS services such as Lambda, Kinesis or DynamoDB.

problem_ideas: A two-person startup wants to ship a React web app with sign-in and hosting this week: which service?
10,000 smart thermostats must send readings every minute to AWS: which service receives them?
Spot the distractor: 'Amplify connects factory sensors to AWS.'
Amplify vs Elastic Beanstalk: a frontend-and-mobile requirement vs deploying a Java web app. Choose each.
Route device telemetry from IoT Core into a real-time stream for analysis: name the downstream service.
A mobile app needs offline data sync and user sign-up: which service family covers it?
